scientific_integrity.computational_scope: Exact finite checks r,s = (2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3), with independent fixed-point-family enumeration for (2,2). No infinite claim inferred from finite tests.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No classification of all inclusion-maximal families, general arbitrary height-two posets, higher weak orders, or closure maps that fail to preserve meets. Previously published equivalent formulations remain possible.
scientific_integrity.prior_dependency: Lindenhovius-Ochs finite-poset subset/nucleus bijection is established literature, not a new result.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Explicit finite-poset nucleus representation, direct composite comparison, cycle obstruction through unique increasing matchings, connected spanning-tree equality case, and inclusion-case enumeration.
scientific_integrity.proven_scope: All complete height-two posets with labelled antichain levels of sizes r,s >= 2. All nuclei of the upset Heyting algebra, exact commutation criterion, sharp maximum size and equality classification, ordered commuting-pair formula and balanced asymptotics.

title: Extremal commuting nuclei on complete two-level finite Heyting frames
